title: Geometric connectedness of the generic fibre spreads for finite-type morphisms over irreducible bases
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first passes to an étale base change making generic components geometrically irreducible. It then spreads their closures and their pairwise incidence graph simultaneously, using flatness of the nonempty intersections to preserve the graph and connectedness over every geometric fibre.
